Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:17:1.hebrew: הוה ליה שלישי בראשון - בני שלישי הוא, ואחי אבא ראשון — דאבא ואחיו ראשונים, ואני שני, ובני שלישי — ואמר רב דשלישי לא יעיד בראשון:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:17:1.english: It is a third with a first - My son is third [generation] and my father's brother is first — for my father and his brother are first, and I am second, and my son is third — and Rav said that a third may not testify regarding a first.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:17:2.hebrew: ואנן - במתני' שני בשני ושני בראשון תנן, אבל כולי האי לא פסיל מתני':
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:17:2.english: And we - In the Mishnah we learned second [generation] with second and second with first, but to such an extent the Mishnah did not disqualify.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:17:3.hebrew: שני בשני - כגון אחי אביו ובנו. אחי אבא לי ואני לו — הרי ראשון בשני ושני בראשון. בן אחי אבא לי ואני לו — הרי שני בשני. אבל בני לאחי אבא — לא תנן:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:17:3.english: A second with a second - For example, his father's brother and his son. My father's brother [in relation] to me, and I to him — behold, [this is] a first [generation] with a second, and a second with a first. The son of my father's brother [in relation] to me, and I to him — behold, [this is] a second with a second. But my son [in relation] to my father's brother — we did not learn [this in the Mishnah].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:18:1.hebrew: מאי חתנו דקתני מתני' - אחי אביו ובנו וחתנו — האי חתנו דמתני' אבנו קאי, דהוה שלישי האי חתן. ולקמן פריך: א"כ, הוה שלישי בשני:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:18:1.english: What is “his son-in-law” that the mishna teaches? - [Regarding the case of] his paternal uncle, and his son, and his son-in-law — this [mention of] “his son-in-law” in the mishna refers to his son, so that this son-in-law is [a relative of the] third [generation]. And later [the Gemara] objects: If so, he would be a third [generation relative testifying about a] second [generation relative].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:1:1.hebrew: אשכחן אבות לבנים - ראובן לבן שמעון, דהיינו אחי אביו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:1:1.english: We found fathers regarding sons - [Such as] Reuven [testifying] about the son of Shimon, that is, his father's brother.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:1:2.hebrew: ובנים לאבות - בן שמעון לראובן, דהיינו בן אחיו. וכל שכן אבות להדדי, דהא בנים מכח דידהו קא אתו. ואימעיטו להו מהאי קרא: אחיו, ובנו, ואחי אביו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:1:2.english: And children about fathers - [For example, the testimony of] the son of Shimon about Reuven, that is, a brother’s son. And all the more so [are] fathers [disqualified from testifying] about each other, since the sons come [into relationship only] by virtue of them. And [thus] excluded by this verse are: his brother, and his son, and his father’s brother.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:20:1.hebrew: אגב אורחיה - דבעי לאשמועינן שלישי פסול, נקט חתן בנו, דאשמועינן נמי בעל כאשתו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:20:1.english: In passing - Since it wanted to teach us that [a relative in the] third [generation] is disqualified, it stated [the case of] the son-in-law of his son, so that it would also teach us that a husband is like his wife.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:21:1.hebrew: שמנה אבות - עם בניהם וחתניהם הוו כ"ד. אע"ג דבמתני' תשעה תנן — בר מחורגו, שאין בן וחתן עמו — לקמן פריך להו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:21:1.english: Eight fathers - Together with their sons and their sons-in-law, they are twenty-four. Even though in the Mishnah we learned nine — aside from his stepson, whose son and son-in-law are not [disqualified] with him — later [the Gemara] raises a difficulty regarding them.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:21:2.hebrew: תלתין ותרתין - ח' אבות, וח' בנים, וח' חתנים, וח' בני בנים. ואע"ג דאיכא תו ח' חתנים, שם חתנות חד קרי ליה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:21:2.english: Thirty-two - Eight fathers, and eight sons, and eight sons-in-law, and eight grandsons. And even though there are an additional eight sons-in-law, he calls [them] a single category of son-in-law.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:22:1.hebrew: ואמאי קרי ליה - רב לחתנו דמתני' חתן בנו? כיון דחתן לא הוי מזרעו ומעלמא אתי, כדור שלישי חשיב ליה רב; והלכך, בני נמי לאחי אבא — דהוי שלישי בראשון — פסול. ואיכא לאקשויי לרב: כיון דאמר חתן כדור אחר דמי, אמאי פסול חתנו לאחי אבא? הוה ליה רביעי בראשון! אלא, מילתא אחריתי אקשי ליה, עד דאפקיה מהאי טעמא לגמרי:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:22:1.english: And why does he call him - [Why did] Rav [refer to] the son-in-law of the Mishnah [as] "the son-in-law of his son"? Since a son-in-law is not of his offspring and comes from outside, Rav considered him like a third generation; and therefore, my son as well [with regard to] my father's brother — which is [a case of] a third [generation] to a first — is disqualified. And one could raise a difficulty against Rav: Since he said [that] a son-in-law is considered like another generation, why is his son-in-law disqualified [from testifying] about my father's brother? That would make him a fourth [generation] to a first! Rather, [the Gemara] raised another difficulty against him, until it removed him from this reasoning entirely.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:23:1.hebrew: אי הכי - דחתן נמי כדור אחר דמי, וקתני מתני': "חתן אחי אבא פסול לי" — הוה ליה שלישי פסול להעיד בשני; ורב אכשר שלישי בשני, דקאמר: "אף אני לא אעיד לו, אני ובני" — אבל בני לבנו יעיד:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:23:1.english: If that is so - That a son-in-law is also considered like another generation, and the Mishnah teaches: "The son-in-law of [my] father’s brother is disqualified for me" — [then] this is a member of the third [generation] disqualified from testifying about [a member of] the second [generation]; and Rav deemed a member of the third [generation] fit [to testify] about [a member of] the second [generation], as he said: "Furthermore, I will not testify about him, [neither] I nor my son" — but my son may testify about his son.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:24:1.hebrew: ה"ג אלא רב דאמר כר"א - ולעולם, חתן לאו כדור אחר דמי; ורב דפסיל שלישי בראשון — כר' אלעזר, דאמר שלישי בשני פסול, וכ"ש שלישי בראשון. ומיהו, לית הלכתא כוותיה, דאמרינן ביש נוחלין (ב"ב ד' קכח.) דשלישי (בראשון) כשר, והלכתא כוותיה דרב, מדבתראי הוה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:24:1.english: This is the correct reading: Rather, Rav stated in accordance with Rabbi Elazar - And in truth, a son-in-law is not considered like another generation; and Rav, who disqualified a third [generation relative] with regard to a first [generation relative, stated this] in accordance with Rabbi Elazar, who says [that] a third [generation relative] with regard to a second [generation relative] is disqualified, and all the more so a third with regard to a first. However, the halakhah is not in accordance with his view, as we say in [the chapter entitled] Yesh Noḥalin (Bava Batra 128a) that a third [generation relative] (with regard to a first) is valid; and the halakhah is in accordance with Rav [i.e., Rava], since he was among the later [authorities].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:24:2.hebrew: בן בנו של אחי אבא - לדידי הוי שלישי בשני, ורב — שלישי בראשון נפקא ליה מדכתיב בנים — הוו שנים:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:24:2.english: The son of the son of [my] father’s brother - To me, he is a third [generation] to a second [generation]; and Rav derives [the disqualification of] a third [generation] with a first [generation] from that which is written: "Sons" — they are two [generations].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:27:1.hebrew: וי"ו לרבות בני בנים - דפסולין לאבות, דהוה שלישי בראשון:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:27:1.english: [The letter] vav [serves] to include grandsons - That they are disqualified [from testifying] about the fathers, as this is [a case of a member of the] third [generation] with [a member of the] first [generation].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:28:1.hebrew: רבי אלעזר - כרב סבירא ליה, דוי"ו לרבות אתא, ודריש "על בנים" למימר דכל דפסילי לאבות פסול לבנים. הלכך, כי היכי דג' בראשון פסול, שלישי בשני נמי פסול:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:28:1.english: Rabbi Elazar - [He] holds in accordance with Rav that [the letter] vav comes to include [an additional generation], and he expounds “for the children” to mean that anyone who is disqualified [from testifying] about the fathers is disqualified [from testifying] about the children. Therefore, just as a third [generation relative testifying] about a first [generation relative] is disqualified, a third [generation relative testifying] about a second [generation relative] is also disqualified.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:29:1.hebrew: ותנא תונא - תנא דידן, כמו אבונא, אחונא. חתן בעל אחותי פסול לי ואני לו, שאני אחי חמותו; ואני לחתן בעל אחות אבי — בן אחי חמותו אני; ולחתן בעל אחות אמי — בן אחות חמותו אני. מילתיה דרב נחמן מחתניהן דקתני מתני' יליף. וכן מילתיה דרב אשי — מחתניהן דאחיו ואחי אביו ואחי אמו, שפסולין לו והוא להם; הוי איהו לגבייהו: אחי חמיו, ובן אחי חמיו, ובן אחות חמיו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:29:1.english: And the Tanna taught [likewise] - [Tona means] our Tanna, like avuna [“our father”] and aḥuna [“our brother”]. The son-in-law of my sister’s husband is disqualified [from testifying] about me, and I about him, for I am the brother of his mother-in-law; and I, to the son-in-law of my father’s sister’s husband, am the son of the brother of his mother-in-law; and to the son-in-law of my mother’s sister’s husband, I am the son of the sister of his mother-in-law. Rav Naḥman’s statement is derived from “their sons-in-law” that the Mishnah teaches. And similarly, Rav Ashi’s statement [is derived] from the sons-in-law of his brother, his father’s brother, and his mother’s brother, who are disqualified [from testifying] about him and he about them — [as] he is, in relation to them, the brother of their father-in-law, the son of the brother of their father-in-law, and the son of the sister of their father-in-law.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:3:1.hebrew: בנים להדדי מנלן - דקתני במתני', בן אחי אביו פסול לו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:3:1.english: From where do we [derive] children [testifying] about each other? - As it is taught in the Mishnah: The son of one’s father’s brother is disqualified regarding him.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:4:1.hebrew: ליכתוב לא יומתו אבות על הבן - דכיון דכתיב אבות, שני אחים משמע; ועל הבן הוי משמע: בנו של כל אחד ואחד הוי פסול לשניהם:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:4:1.english: Let [the verse] write: “The fathers shall not be put to death for the child” - For since it is written “fathers,” it implies two brothers; and “for the child” would have implied [that] the son of each one is disqualified [from testifying about] both of them.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:5:1.english: About others - That two relatives are disqualified from testifying about a person from the street.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:6:1.hebrew: בעדות אחיו - דאי לאו דאסהיד האי קרובו בהדיה, לא הוה מיקטל; נמצא, בנים מתים זה על זה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:6:1.english: Based on the testimony of his brother - For had this relative of his not testified with him, he would not be executed; [thus] it turns out [that] children die on account of one another.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:7:1.hebrew: שלשה אחים ואחד - מן השוק עם כל אחד ואחד מעידים על אכילת שני חזקה של קרקע של אדם מן השוק. ומעיד אחד מן האחין והבא מן השוק על שנה ראשונה, ואחד מן האחין והבא מן השוק על שנה שניה, והשלישי על השלישית. והרי אלו שלש עדיות, והחזקה קיימת, ולא אמרי': עדות אחת היא והרי העדים קרובים; אלא ג' עדיות נינהו, דאשתא דקא מסהיד האי לא מסהיד האי:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:7:1.english: Three brothers and one — [unrelated person] from the general public [who joins] with each and every one [of them], testify about the consumption [of produce during] the years of presumptive ownership of the land of an individual from the general public. And one of the brothers and the one who came from the general public testify about the first year, and one of the brothers and the one who came from the general public [testify] about the second year, and the third [brother testifies] about the third [year]. And behold, these are three [separate sets of] testimony, and the presumptive ownership is established; and we do not say, “It is one [single set of] testimony, and behold, the witnesses are relatives [and disqualified],” but rather they are three [distinct sets of] testimony, for in the year that this one testifies, that one does not testify.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:7:2.hebrew: והן עדות אחת להזמה - דעד דמתזמי כולהו לא משלמי ממונא, דהא לא הוה מתוקמא בידא דלוקח אלא בסהדותא דכולהו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:7:2.english: And they are one testimony for [rendering them] conspiring witnesses - For until all of them are rendered conspiring [witnesses], they do not pay money, as [the land] would not be established in the possession of the buyer except through the testimony of all of them.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:9:1.hebrew: אלא הזמה מעלמא קא אתי להו - ע"י המזימין אותן הן משלמים, ולא זה על יד זה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28a:9:1.english: Rather, [the status of] conspiring witnesses comes to them from the outside - Through those who render them conspiring witnesses they pay, and not this [one] through that [one].

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:18:1.hebrew: מאי חתנו דקתני מתני' חתן בנו - תימה: א"כ, מתני' דקתני: "גיסו ובנו וחתנו" — היינו חתן בנו; אלמא חתן בן אחות אשתו פסול?! הא אפי' חתן בן אשתו כשר, דקתני: "חורגו לבדו"! וי"ל, דכיון דחתנו הוי חתן בנו, איכא למימר דחורגו לאו למעוטי בן חורגו וחתן חורגו, אלא אתא למעוטי בן בן חורגו וחתן בן חורגו:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:18:1.english: "What is 'his son-in-law' that the Mishnah teaches? The son-in-law of his son" - This is astonishing: If so, when the Mishnah teaches, "[One's] brother-in-law, and his son, and his son-in-law," this means the son-in-law of his son. It follows that the son-in-law of the son of his wife's sister is disqualified [from testifying]! But even the son-in-law of his [own] wife's son is eligible, as [the Mishnah] teaches: "And his stepson alone"! And it can be answered that since "his son-in-law" is the son-in-law of his son, it can be said that "his stepson [alone]" does not come to exclude his stepson's son and his stepson's son-in-law; rather, it comes to exclude the son of his stepson's son and the son-in-law of his stepson's son.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:21:1.hebrew: שמונה אבות שהן כ"ד - איכא טובא דחדא נינהו, אלא לפום ריהטא דמתני' קחשיב:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:21:1.english: "Eight fathers, which are twenty-four" - There are many [relatives among them] that are one and the same; rather, [Rabbi Ḥiyya] is counting according to the routine flow of the Mishnah.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:21:2.hebrew: תלתין ותרתין הוו - הא דלא קאמר ארבעים הוו: הם, ובניהם, וחתניהם, וחתן בניהם, ובני בניהם — משום דלא קתני להו בהדיא במתני'. אי נמי: שם חתנות חד הוא:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:21:2.english: "They are thirty-two" - The reason that [the Gemara] did not say, "They are forty" — [namely,] they themselves, their sons, their sons-in-law, their sons' sons-in-law, and their grandsons — is because [the Mishnah] does not teach them explicitly in the Mishnah. Alternatively, the category of son-in-law is one [and the same].

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:21:3.hebrew: (תלתין ותרתין הוו - פי' הקונט' דחתן בניהם לא חשיב, דשם חתנות חדא הוא; ור"י אומר דבני בניהם לא חשיב, משום דלא קתני להו במתני' בהדיא):
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:21:3.english: ("These are thirty-two" - The Kuntres [Rashi] explains that the son-in-law of their sons is not counted, as the category of son-in-law is one; and the Ri says that the sons of their sons are not counted, because [the Mishnah] does not teach them explicitly in the Mishnah).

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:22:1.hebrew: כיון דמעלמא אתי כדור אחר דמי - פ"ה: והא דלא אקשי' ליה לרב: כיון דאמרת כדור אחר דמי, אמאי פסול חתנו לאחי אביו, הוה ליה רביעי בראשון? משום דקשיא ליה מילתא אחריתי. והקשה הר"ר יוסף, אחי הר"ף, להר"ף: דאמאי לא מקשי לרב דאכשר ג' בשני, דקאמר: "אחי אבא לא יעיד לי, הוא ובנו וחתנו", וחתנו כדור אחר דמי, א"כ פסול שלישי בשני? ותירץ הר"ף: אה"נ דהוה מצי לאקשויי הכי, אלא משום דאקשי ליה מילתא אחריתי לא אסיק אדעתיה; דהכי נמי תירץ בשיטת הקונטרס:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:22:1.english: "Since he comes from outside [the family], he is considered like another generation" - Rashi explained: And the reason we did not object to Rav: "Since you say [a son-in-law] is considered like another generation, why is his son-in-law disqualified [from testifying] concerning his father's brother? He would be a fourth [generation relative] concerning the first [generation]!" — [is] because he [the questioner] had another difficulty [to raise against him]. And Rabbi Yosef, the brother of Rabbeinu Peretz, asked Rabbeinu Peretz: Why did [the Gemara] not object to Rav, who deemed a third [generation relative] fit concerning a second [generation relative] — for [Rav] said: "My father's brother will not testify about me, [neither] he, nor his son, nor his son-in-law," and [since] his son-in-law is considered like another generation, if so, a third [generation relative] is disqualified concerning a second [generation relative]? And Rabbeinu Peretz answered: Indeed, it could have raised this objection, but because it [already] raised another difficulty against him, it did not occur to it [to raise this one as well] — for so too did he answer in the commentary of the Kunteres.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:24:1.hebrew: רב דאמר כר' אלעזר - אומר ר"ת, דכן הלכה: דשלישי בראשון פסול — כדמוכח בפ' יש נוחלין (ב"ב ד' קנח: ושם), דשלח ליה ר' אבא לרב יוסף בר חמא: "הלכה: שלישי בשני כשר", ומשמע: הא בראשון — פסול; ואמר התם דהכי הלכתא. ובירושלמי נמי אמרי': "משה, מהו להעיד באשת פנחס?" ואמר ר' יוחנן: "כשר". ומדנקט "אשת פנחס", משמע: דלפנחס לא יעיד, דהוה שלישי בראשון. והא דלא אמרינן "אשה כבעלה", כי הכא באשת חורגו — משום דהתם איתפלג דרא:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28a:24:1.english: Rav stated [his ruling] in accordance with Rabbi Elazar - Rabbeinu Tam says that this is indeed the halakhah: that [a relative of] the third [generation testifying] concerning [one of] the first [generation] is disqualified, as is proven in the chapter [entitled] Yesh Noḥalin (Bava Batra 158b, and there), where Rabbi Abba sent to Rav Yosef bar Ḥama: "The halakhah is: [a relative of] the third [generation] concerning [one of] the second [generation] is valid [to testify]." And this implies: but concerning [one of] the first [generation, he is] disqualified; and it said there that this is indeed the halakhah. And in the Yerushalmi we also say: "What is [the ruling regarding whether] Moses [may] testify concerning the wife of Phinehas?" And Rabbi Yoḥanan said: "[He is] valid." And since it formulated [the question specifically as] "the wife of Phinehas," it implies that concerning Phinehas [himself], he could not testify, because he was [a relative of] the third [generation] concerning [one of] the first [generation]. And that which we do not say [there] "a wife is like her husband," as [we do] here regarding the wife of one's stepson, is because there the generation was divided:
